defmodule InferenceServer.Logger do
  @moduledoc "Structured logging for ML inference server"

  require Logger

  @log_format ~r/^[\x20-\x7E]+$/

  def audit_log(event, metadata) do
    timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    entry = format_entry(timestamp, event, metadata)
    File.write!(log_path(), entry <> "\n", [:append])
  end

  defp format_entry(timestamp, event, metadata) do
    meta_str = metadata |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> "#{k}=#{sanitize_value(v)}" end) |> Enum.join(", ")
    "[#{timestamp}] event=#{event} #{meta_str}"
  end

  defp sanitize_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/, "")
    |> String.replace("\n", "")
    |> String.replace("\r", "")
    |> truncate(256)
  end

  defp sanitize_value(value), do: inspect(value)

  defp truncate(str, max) when byte_size(str) > max, do: String.slice(str, 0, max)
  defp truncate(str, _max), do: str

  defp log_path, do: Application.get_env(:inference_server, :audit_log_path, "/var/log/inference/audit.log")
end

defmodule InferenceServer.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Role-based access control for inference endpoints"

  @roles %{
    "admin" => [:predict, :train, :manage_models, :view_logs],
    "data_scientist" => [:predict, :train, :view_logs],
    "api_user" => [:predict]
  }

  def authorize(user, action) do
    role = user.role
    permissions = Map.get(@roles, role, [])

    if action in permissions do
      InferenceServer.Logger.audit_log("auth_success", %{
        user: user.username,
        role: role,
        action: to_string(action)
      })
      {:ok, user}
    else
      InferenceServer.Logger.audit_log("auth_failure", %{
        user: user.username,
        role: role,
        action: to_string(action)
      })
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end
end

defmodule InferenceServer.ModelRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Registry for ML models with versioning"

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def get_model(pid, model_name) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:get_model, model_name})
  end

  def handle_call({:get_model, name}, _from, state) do
    {:reply, Map.get(state, name, {:error, :not_found}), state}
  end
end

defmodule InferenceServer.Predictor do
  @moduledoc "Handles ML model inference requests"

  alias InferenceServer.{Auth, Logger, ModelRegistry}

  defstruct [:model_name, :input_data, :parameters]

  def predict(user, request) do
    with {:ok, _user} <- Auth.authorize(user, :predict),
         {:ok, model} <- load_model(request.model_name),
         {:ok, result} <- run_inference(model, request.input_data, request.parameters) do
      Logger.audit_log("inference_complete", %{
        user: user.username,
        model: request.model_name,
        input_shape: describe_shape(request.input_data),
        latency_ms: result.latency_ms
      })
      {:ok, result}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.audit_log("inference_error", %{
          user: user.username,
          model: request.model_name,
          error: format_error(reason)
        })
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp load_model(model_name) do
    # Simulated model loading
    {:ok, %{name: model_name, version: "1.0.0"}}
  end

  defp run_inference(model, input_data, parameters) do
    start_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    # Simulated inference
    result = %{prediction: [0.85, 0.12, 0.03], confidence: 0.85}
    latency = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
    {:ok, Map.put(result, :latency_ms, latency)}
  end

  defp describe_shape(data) when is_list(data), do: "[#{length(data)}]"
  defp describe_shape(data) when is_map(data), do: "map(#{map_size(data)})"
  defp describe_shape(_), do: "scalar"

  defp format_error(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: Atom.to_string(reason)
  defp format_error(reason) when is_binary(reason), do: reason
  defp format_error(reason), do: inspect(reason)
end

defmodule InferenceServer.Router do
  @moduledoc "HTTP request routing with user context extraction"

  alias InferenceServer.{Predictor, Logger}

  def handle_request(%{path: "/predict", method: "POST"} = conn) do
    user = extract_user(conn)
    request = parse_predict_request(conn.body)

    case Predictor.predict(user, request) do
      {:ok, result} -> %{status: 200, body: result}
      {:error, :unauthorized} -> %{status: 403, body: "Forbidden"}
      {:error, _} -> %{status: 500, body: "Internal error"}
    end
  end

  def handle_request(%{path: "/health"} = _conn) do
    %{status: 200, body: "ok"}
  end

  def handle_request(%{path: path} = conn) do
    user = extract_user(conn)
    Logger.audit_log("unknown_route", %{
      user: user.username,
      path: path,
      method: conn.method
    })
    %{status: 404, body: "Not found"}
  end

  defp extract_user(conn) do
    # In production, this would validate JWT/session
    username = Map.get(conn.headers, "x-username", "anonymous")
    role = Map.get(conn.headers, "x-role", "api_user")
    user_agent = Map.get(conn.headers, "user-agent", "unknown")

    Logger.audit_log("request_received", %{
      user: username,
      role: role,
      user_agent: user_agent,
      ip: conn.remote_ip
    })

    %{username: username, role: role}
  end

  defp parse_predict_request(body) do
    %Predictor{
      model_name: body["model"],
      input_data: body["input"],
      parameters: body["parameters"] || %{}
    }
  end
end
